item.title: Marketplace at Nexton Welcomes New Businesses
item.description: The Marketplace at Nexton continues to expand its reputation as a vibrant hub for shopping, dining and services with the addition of several new businesses now open for residents and visitors to enjoy.

item.title: Bellerose opens its reservation books on Dec. 17
item.description: Bellerose Hotel Bar, a nine-table steakhouse located beside the soon-to-open Sushi Bar Charleston, will open its reservation books on Dec. 17. The sibling concepts will offer distinct dining experiences but share the same culinary team.

item.title: Annual Bill Murray Polar Bear Plunge Returns on New Year's Day 2026
item.description: Folly Beach has announced details for its annual Bill Murray Polar Bear Plunge, set for New Year’s Day at 11 a.m.

item.title: Pinky’s on the Beach to host Polar Plunge After Party
item.description: After braving the icy Atlantic during Folly Beach’s annual Bill Murray Look-a-Like Polar Bear Plunge, you can head to Pinky’s on the Beach for its official after-party on Thursday, Jan. 1, starting at noon.

item.title: Folly Beach Shares Details on 2025 New Year's Eve Flip Flop Drop
item.description: Folly Beach has announced details for its annual New Year’s Eve Flip Flop Drop and Fireworks Show, set for Dec. 31, 2025.

item.title: Home Team BBQ Hosts 8th Annual Rock the Block on Feb. 21
item.description: Home Team BBQ’s Rock the Block is back for its 8th year, transforming the restaurant’s downtown Williman Street location into a neighborhood street party featuring a full afternoon of live music, guest-chef bites, and more

item.title: Commentary: A Stronger Rail Network Means a Stronger Future for Outdoor Businesses
item.description: Running a hunting and fishing distribution company in South Carolina gives a unique perspective on how critical reliable shipping really is.

item.title: Governor's Mansion Christmas Open House Scheduled for Dec. 7
item.description: Governor Henry McMaster and First Lady Peggy McMaster invite South Carolinians and their families to join them for a Christmas Open House on Sunday, December 7 from 2:00 to 4:00 PM at the Governor's Mansion.
